# Exercise every state through add, move, start, done, reopen, and rename.
exec weft$exe init

exec weft$exe add 'Default state title'
stdout 'Created 001 Default state title'
exists tasks/backlog/001-default-state-title.md

exec weft$exe add title with several words --state=todo --json
json
stdout '"number": "002"'
stdout '"title": "title with several words"'
exists tasks/todo/002-title-with-several-words.md

exec weft$exe add --json -- '--literal title'
json
stdout '"title": "--literal title"'

exec weft$exe add 'Created complete' --state done --json
json
stdout '"state": "done"'
stdout '"completed_at":'
exists tasks/done/004-created-complete.md

exec weft$exe move 001 todo --json
json
stdout '"state": "todo"'
! exists tasks/backlog/001-default-state-title.md
exists tasks/todo/001-default-state-title.md
exec weft$exe move 001 todo
stdout 'already todo'

exec weft$exe start 001
stdout '001 Default state title -> doing'
exec weft$exe start 001
stdout 'already doing'
exists tasks/doing/001-default-state-title.md

exec weft$exe done 001 --json
json
stdout '"state": "done"'
exec weft$exe done 001
stdout 'already done'
cp tasks/done/001-default-state-title.md completed-once.md
exec weft$exe done 001
cmp tasks/done/001-default-state-title.md completed-once.md

exec weft$exe start 001 --json
json
stdout '"state": "doing"'
! stdout '"completed_at":'
exec weft$exe done 001
exec weft$exe reopen 001
stdout '001 reopened in doing'
exec weft$exe reopen 001
stdout 'already doing'
! exists tasks/done/001-default-state-title.md
exists tasks/doing/001-default-state-title.md

exec weft$exe move 001 backlog
exists tasks/backlog/001-default-state-title.md
exec weft$exe move 001 done
exists tasks/done/001-default-state-title.md
exec weft$exe move 001 doing
exists tasks/doing/001-default-state-title.md

exec weft$exe rename 001 'Renamed work item' --json
json
stdout '"title": "Renamed work item"'
exists tasks/doing/001-renamed-work-item.md
exec weft$exe rename 001 'Renamed work item'
stdout 'Renamed 001 Renamed work item'
exec weft$exe show 001
stdout '^# Renamed work item$'

exec weft$exe check --json
json
stdout '"ok": true'
stdout '"task_count": 4'
